zh.title: FAA規定飛機後推後頭等艙禁止飲用飲料 航空公司須提前展開服務
zh.summary: FAA指示飛機後推後頭等艙禁止飲用飲料；達美等航空業者須提前收納廚房物品。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，美國聯邦航空管理局（FAA）發布最新指令，規定頭等艙乘客在飛機進行後推作業之後，將不再被允許飲用飲料。這項新規定要求頭等艙乘客在飛機開始移動前必須停止飲用飲料。
這項規定影響包括達美航空在內的多家航空公司。為了符合監管要求，達美航空與其他航空公司必須更早開始提供起飛前的客艙服務，以確保服務與收納作業順利完成。
根據新規要求，所有廚房物品必須在飛機開始移動之前完成收納。航空公司必須調整起飛前服務作業流程，確保在飛機執行後推與移動前，妥善收納所有廚房物品。

en.title: FAA Order Bans First Class Passengers From Sipping Beverages After Pushback
en.summary: FAA orders carriers like Delta to end first class beverage service before aircraft pushback.
body: According to a Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) order, first class passengers will no longer be allowed to sip beverages after aircraft pushback. The regulatory directive requires passenger beverage consumption to cease prior to aircraft movement.

Under the directive, airlines including Delta Air Lines must initiate pre-departure cabin service earlier than before. Airlines are required to ensure that all galley items are fully stowed before aircraft movement begins.

Carriers must adjust their pre-departure timelines to accommodate early service delivery. This operational adjustment ensures that flight attendants can complete beverage service and stow all service equipment in galley compartments before the aircraft pushes back from the gate.

zh.title: 美國聯邦航空總署關注逾470架波音737 MAX機身完整性
zh.summary: FAA關注逾470架波音737 MAX機身完整性；數百架客機未來須接受特定檢查。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）近期對超過 470 架波音 737 MAX 客機的機身結構完整性表達關注。該監管機構正針對相關客機的機身狀態維持進行評估與監督。
為確保航空器持續符合飛航安全規範，數百架波音 737 MAX 系列客機預計將在未來幾年內接受特定的專項檢查作業。
相關檢查要求將適用於受影響的波音 737 MAX 機隊，營運單位後續須依照規範時程排定檢修，以維護機身結構之安全性。

en.title: FAA Raises Concerns Over Fuselage Integrity of Over 470 Boeing 737 MAX Aircraft
en.summary: FAA voices concern over 470 Boeing 737 MAX fuselages; hundreds of aircraft require future inspections.
body: According to a report published by Simple Flying, the United States Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has raised concerns over the structural fuselage integrity of more than 470 Boeing 737 MAX aircraft.
In light of these airworthiness considerations, hundreds of Boeing 737 MAX aircraft will require specific targeted inspections in the years ahead to evaluate fuselage integrity.
The regulatory focus centers on ensuring that affected aircraft undergo necessary detailed inspection protocols to maintain high standards of safety and structural reliability.
These required maintenance actions are expected to be performed by operators over the coming years in accordance with regulatory oversight.
